title: Variance of four equally spaced values
source: Theory S1-3.3 Quick check 1 (5); mean of squared deviations
stem: The four values \({a|int}\), \({b|int}\), \({c|int}\) and \({d|int}\) have mean \({m|int}\). Find the variance of these values.

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: The squared deviations from \({m|int}\) add to 20, so the variance is \(5\).
steps.note: A is 5 for this equally spaced set. Original 1,3,5,7 with mean 4 give variance 5.

title: Variance from Sigma x and Sigma x^2
source: Theory S1-3.3 Quick check 2 (5); mean of squares minus square of mean
stem: For four values, \(\Sigma x={sx|int}\) and \(\Sigma x^2={sq|int}\). Find the variance.

steps.name: A
steps.note: A is 5k^2. Original k=1 gives Sigma x=20, Sigma x^2=120, variance 5.

title: Standard deviation of four values
source: Theory S1-3.3 Quick check 3 (3); square root of the variance
stem: The four values 1, 1, \({q|int}\) and \({q|int}\) have mean \({d|int}+1\). Find the standard deviation of these values.

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: The variance is \({d|int}^2\), so the standard deviation is \({A|int}\).
steps.note: A is d. Original d=3 gives the values 1,1,7,7 with mean 4, variance 9 and standard deviation 3.

title: Mean and standard deviation of two combined data sets

source.note: 9709/63/M/J/11 Question 1 [6]. Official QP and official MS.

stem:
This question is 9709/63/M/J/11 Question 1, taken from the official QP.

Red Street Garage has 9 used cars for sale. Fairwheel Garage has 15 used cars for sale. The mean age of the cars in Red Street Garage is 3.6 years and the standard deviation is 1.925 years. In Fairwheel Garage, Σ x = 64 and Σ x² = 352, where x is the age of a car in years.

(i) Find the mean age of all 24 cars. [2]

(ii) Find the standard deviation of the ages of all 24 cars. [4]

steps.name: M
steps.text_tex: The mean age of all 24 cars is \(4.02\) years.
steps.note: Official MS: M1 for (3.6 times 9 + 64)/24. Independent: (32.4+64)/24=96.4/24=4.0166...=4.02 years.

steps.name: S
steps.note: Official MS: M1 attempt to find Sigma x_A^2 using the correct variance formula. From Sigma x_A^2 / 9 - 3.6^2 = 1.925^2.

steps.name: U
steps.text_tex: The standard deviation of all 24 cars is \(2.19\).
steps.note: Official MS: M1 using 352 + their 150 in the correct variance formula. Independent: 502/24 - (96.4/24)^2 leads to sd=2.19.

contexts.note: Stem taken from the official QP PDF, Question 1. Official MS reproduced mark by mark. Paper/self-mark.
